descriptionLt: Logistikos partneris, kuris koordinuoja platesni paslaugu paketa, pvz. sandeliavima, transporta ir uzsakymu valdyma.
descriptionEn: A logistics partner coordinating a broader service package, such as warehousing, transport and order management.

descriptionLt: Medziagu ar komponentu sarasas, reikalingas produktui, rinkiniui, pakavimui ar kitai operacijai atlikti.
descriptionEn: A list of materials or components required to make a product, kit, packing setup or another operation.

descriptionLt: Pilnas krovinys, kai masina ar priekaba skiriama vienam klientui, marsrutui ar siuntai.
descriptionEn: A full load where a vehicle or trailer is dedicated to one customer, route or shipment.

descriptionLt: Marsruto sustojimas, kuriame iskraunama, perduodama arba paimama siunta.
descriptionEn: A route stop where a shipment is unloaded, handed over or collected.

descriptionLt: Svarbi marsruto arba proceso vieta, pvz. klientas, rampa, sandelis ar tarpinis sustojimas.
descriptionEn: An important route or process location, such as a customer, dock, warehouse or intermediate stop.

descriptionLt: Pristatymo patvirtinimas: dokumentas, parasas, skaitmeninis irasas ar kitas irodymas, kad krovinys pristatytas.
descriptionEn: Delivery confirmation: a document, signature, digital record or other evidence that the load was delivered.

descriptionLt: Imones verslo sistema, jungianti finansus, pirkimus, pardavimus, atsargas, gamyba ar kitus pagrindinius procesus.
descriptionEn: A business system connecting finance, purchasing, sales, inventory, production or other core company processes.

descriptionLt: Sandelio buhalterinis kodas pagal kuri galima suprasti kokiu statusu yra laikoma preke.
descriptionEn: Warehouse accounting code, which allows you to understand the status of the product.

descriptionLt: Numatomas transporto, siuntos ar prekiu atvykimo laikas.
descriptionEn: The expected arrival time of a vehicle, shipment or goods.

descriptionLt: Atsargu naudojimo logika, kai pirmiausia isduodama seniausiai gauta preke ar partija. Daznai svarbu galiojimams ir rotacijai.
descriptionEn: An inventory logic where the earliest received goods or batch are issued first. Often important for expiry and stock rotation.

descriptionLt: Atsargu naudojimo logika, kai pirmiausia isduodama veliausiai gauta preke ar partija.
descriptionEn: An inventory logic where the latest received goods or batch are issued first.

descriptionLt: Prekiu priemimo irasas arba dokumentas, patvirtinantis, kad prekes gautos ir uzregistruotos sandelyje.
descriptionEn: A goods receipt record or document confirming that goods were received and registered in the warehouse.

descriptionLt: Matuojama proceso busena arba rezultatas.
descriptionEn: A measured process state or result.

descriptionLt: Dalinis krovinys, kai viena siunta neuzpildo visos masinos ir gali buti konsoliduojama su kitomis siuntomis.
descriptionEn: A partial load where one shipment does not fill the whole truck and may be consolidated with other shipments.

descriptionLt: Pirkimo uzsakymas, kuriame nurodoma ka, kiek, uz kokia kaina ir kokiomis salygomis perkama.
descriptionEn: A purchasing document stating what is bought, in what quantity, at what price and under which conditions.

descriptionLt: Unikalus prekes ar artikulo identifikatorius, pagal kuri valdoma atsarga, judejimas, kainos ir uzsakymai.
descriptionEn: A unique product or item identifier used to manage stock, movement, prices and orders.

descriptionLt: Sutarti kokybes, laiko ar aptarnavimo isipareigojimai.
descriptionEn: Agreed commitments for quality, time or service delivery.

descriptionLt: Sandelio valdymo sistema, valdanti lokacijas, atsargas, priemima, surinkima, papildyma ir isvezima.(Senoji)
descriptionEn: A warehouse management system controlling locations, stock, receiving, picking, replenishment and outbound dispatch.(OLD)

descriptionLt: Manhatan. Sandelio valdymo sistema, valdanti lokacijas, atsargas, priemima, surinkima, papildyma ir isvezima.
descriptionEn: Manhatan. A warehouse management system controlling locations, stock, receiving, picking, replenishment and outbound dispatch.

descriptionLt: Marsrutizavimo programa naudojama distribucinio transporto pristatymo grafikams generuoti.
descriptionEn: The routing program is used to generate delivery schedules for distribution vehicles.

descriptionLt: Marsrutizavimo programos suformuota duombaze .
descriptionEn: Routing programs are built in a database.

descriptionLt: Europaletė 80x120, standartine, prekems gabenti skirta palete
descriptionEn: Euro pallet 80x120, standard pallet for transporting goods

descriptionLt: Industrine palete 100x120
descriptionEn: Industrial pallet 100x120

descriptionLt: Tai yra sandelio tipo logistinis mazgas, i kuri pristatome prekes tiketina IBL transportu
descriptionEn: This is a warehouse-type logistics hub to which we deliver goods via reliable IBL transport.

descriptionLt: Cross-dock: tai procesas, kai prekės atvyksta i terminalą ar sandeli ir be ilgalaikio sandėliavimo greitai perkraunamos i kita transport.
descriptionEn: Cross-docking is a process where goods arrive at a terminal or warehouse and are quickly transferred to another vehicle without long-term storage.

descriptionLt: Prekių savininko kodas
descriptionEn: Goods owner code

descriptionLt: Stelazo skersine sija, ant kuriu sudetos paletes
descriptionEn: The rack crossbar on which the pallets are placed

descriptionLt: vieta tarp stelazu, skirta krautuvui manevruoti ir paimti / padeti paletes / atrinkti prekes.
descriptionEn: space between racks for a forklift to maneuver and pick up/place pallets/select goods.

titleEn: Aditional floor built inside a warehouse
descriptionLt: tai papildoma tarpine platforma arba aukštas sandelio viduje, įrengiamas virs esamos grindu zonos. Jis leidzia efektyviau isnaudoti sandelio aukšti ir padidinti naudinga plota, nereikalaujant plesti pastato.
descriptionEn: is an intermediate platform or additional floor built inside a warehouse, usually above the existing ground floor area. It allows companies to use the vertical space of the warehouse more efficiently and increase usable floor space without expanding the building..
